scope: Engineering provenance aggregation only; no training, metric, stopping-rule or sampling changes.
requirements: Accept whole template stem and explicit actual child manifest names; require template status absent.
Every child actual queue must have COMPLETE global status, all tasks COMPLETE exit0, matching fixed-launch real PID and status path, and current manifest/status/launch byte hashes.
Require exact nonoverlapping coverage of every whole-template task name and command, allowing only device placeholder replacement by actual cuda device.

Copy each actual task record losslessly. Never invent a queue PID or task PID. Mark whole file DERIVED_STATUS_UNION_NOT_AN_ACTUAL_QUEUE, queue_pid null, and retain all actual sources and their hashes.
Do not register or launch whole template. Use derived status only for immutable input budget/archive verification.
acceptance: Duplicate/missing task rejected before write; normalized actual command equals whole template; task records preserved exactly; derived-source SHA inventory complete.
